groq.name: GroqCloud
groq._note: Free plan (no card): openai/gpt-oss-120b 30 RPM, 1K RPD, 8K TPM (input+output of one request), 200K TPD (console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits, 31 Oct 2026). 8K TPM means big design calls cannot run here; used for light roles.

nvidia.name: NVIDIA NIM (build.nvidia.com) — BENCHMARK ONLY
nvidia._note: NVIDIA API Trial Terms of Service (v. 19 Sep 2025) §1.4: without a paid subscription the API may be used 'only ... for internal testing and evaluation purposes, not in production'. So the engine NEVER routes production jobs here; these models appear only on /benchmark. NVIDIA no longer uses credits; per-model rate limits are not published (shown at the top right of build.nvidia.com; users report ~40 requests/min). Exception: ALLOW_NVIDIA_PRODUCTION=true (owner's own decision and risk) adds them to production routes via engineV3.optInRoutes.nvidia. 31 Oct 2026 probe: mistral-large-4-1t-a52b and glm-5.3-flash now think before answering and are very slow on the free queue (no first byte in 200 s on a design-sized prompt; glm ~50 s even for 'Say OK'), so they were removed from production routes; nemotron-3.5-super-vl needs chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false or it returns only thinking.
nvidia._accountNote: 1 Nov 2026: NVIDIA's free account limit is ~40 requests/min across all models; 38 keeps the v4 designers (2 in parallel) and v3 polish under it.

cloudflare.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
cloudflare._note: Free: 10,000 Neurons/day shared by all models (resets 00:00 UTC). tpd is an approximation of that budget in tokens for gpt-oss-120b; the daily-limit error is also detected.

openrouter.name: OpenRouter (Free Tier)
openrouter._note: Free models: 20 requests/min and 50 requests/day per account; 1000/day once you have bought at least $10 of credits ever (set V3_ACCOUNT_OPENROUTER_RPD=1000).

ollama.name: Ollama Cloud (pay per token)
ollama._note: ollama.com hosted models through an API key, no own server (docs.ollama.com/cloud; OpenAI-compatible at https://ollama.com/v1). NOT free: 'Pay as you go — Pay per token for every cloud model' (ollama.com/pricing, 31 Oct 2026); 3 concurrent requests on pay-as-you-go. One account per person. Only used when OLLAMA_API_KEY is set; OLLAMA_PRIORITY=last moves it to the end of every chain.

mistral.name: Mistral La Plateforme (Free mode)
mistral._note: Free mode: 'API access is enabled by default with no credit card required. Usage and rate limits apply.' (docs.mistral.ai, read 31 Oct 2026). Per-model limits are shown only on admin.mistral.ai Limits page (not public) — the router learns them from 429s. Free mode may use inputs/outputs for training unless the account opts out (Data & Account Controls). Only used when MISTRAL_API_KEY is set.

zai.name: Z.ai (Zhipu) — free Flash models
zai._note: glm-4.7-flash (text, 200K ctx) and glm-4.6v-flash (vision) are listed 'Free' on docs.z.ai/guides/overview/pricing (read 1 Nov 2026); JSON mode via response_format json_object (docs.z.ai/guides/capabilities/struct-output). Free-tier rate limits are only shown after login (z.ai/manage-apikey/rate-limits); ~1 concurrent request reported (unverified) -> concurrency 1; the scheduler learns the rest from 429s. Only used when ZAI_API_KEY is set (one account, no card).

sambanova.name: SambaNova Cloud (free tier)
sambanova._note: Free tier = no payment method linked. Per model: 20 RPM, 20 requests/day, 200,000 tokens/day (docs.sambanova.ai/docs/en/models/rate-limits, 31 Oct 2026). Small daily budget: a backup, not a main route. Only used when SAMBANOVA_API_KEY is set.

engineV3._comment: Engine v3 routes per role, best first ('provider:model'). 1 Nov 2026 route fix (free_tier_deepdive_2026-11-01): design/art = the three real Gemini Flash models first (aliases 3.7->3.8 and 3.5->3.6 removed: same quota, extra 429s; engineV3.aliases makes the quota counter treat them as one model), then Mistral Large 4, DeepSeek-V3.1, GLM-4.7-Flash (Z.ai), OpenRouter free, Gemma 4, gpt-oss-120b. No pay-per-token (Ollama) routes and no Cloudflare text routes (its 10k neurons/day are kept for AI images). vision (QA reviewer + photo editor) = Flash-Lite / Gemma 4 / GLM-4.6V-Flash first so the 20/day Gemini Flash quota goes to slide design. plan (image director) = Flash-Lite / Gemma. Light roles (brief/research/outline) = Groq gpt-oss-120b, Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, Gemma-4-26B, GLM-4.7-Flash, Mistral Small. NVIDIA (incl. Kimi K2.6) only with ALLOW_NVIDIA_PRODUCTION=true (optInRoutes). Every provider is optional: no key = skipped. A 429 or a used-up daily quota moves to the next route at once; a provider failing 3x in a row is benched for 5 min. Override at runtime with ENGINE_V3_ROUTES (same shape as 'roles').

models._comment: Published free-tier limits per model (checked 30 Oct 2026). Groq: console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits (Free plan table). Gemini: ai.google.dev pricing lists these models as 'Free of charge'; per-model daily limits are shown only in AI Studio (aistudio.google.com/rate-limit) — flash models measured at ~20 requests/day/model and flash-lite at ~500/day on a free key in Oct 2026; edit if your key shows more. OpenRouter limits are account-wide (see providers.openrouter). The scheduler also learns from 429 replies, so wrong numbers only cost a retry. Gemma 4 on the Gemini API free tier: 16,000 input tokens/minute per model (from Google's 429 reply); gemma-4-31b often answered HTTP 500 in testing, gemma-4-26b-a4b was reliable and fast. 31 Oct 2026: gemma-4-31b-it on the free Gemini API failed ~90% of calls for an hour (HTTP 500/503/429) while gemma-4-26b-a4b-it answered normally, so 26B is tried before 31B.

nvidia:nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-120b._note: 1 Nov 2026: main NVIDIA designer — full one-slide design in 8.6 s with thinking off.

nvidia:nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b._note: 1 Nov 2026: one-slide design 76 s (33 s queue before first byte), best layout of the NVIDIA models.

mistral:mistral-small-2603._minIntervalNote: paced to <= 1 request/second on the free tier (2026-10-31)

zai:glm-4.7-flash._note: thinking switched off for speed (Z.ai 'thinking' parameter); unverified on the free tier

nvidia:meta/muse-glimmer-30b._note: 1 Nov 2026: one-slide design 34 s (reasons ~25 s first, can't be switched off), valid layout.

nvidia:nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b._note: 1 Nov 2026: tool loop 100% valid calls, one call per turn, ~27 s/slide; weaker colour sense (QA catches contrast).

benchmarkCandidates._comment: Extra models offered ONLY on the /benchmark page (never used for real jobs). NVIDIA = free trial API, testing/evaluation only per NVIDIA's terms. Key: NVIDIA_NIM_API_KEY from build.nvidia.com.

optInRoutes._comment: Routes added to production only when the named env var is 'true'. prepend = tried first; afterGemini = right after the last Gemini route; afterAnchors = after the last Gemini route and the last route of anchorProviders (e.g. NVIDIA's slow free queue after Mistral/SambaNova); append = after the normal routes.

nvidia._comment2: 1 Nov 2026 (owner, testing phase): NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is the main designer when DESIGN_PRIMARY=nvidia; Nemotron 3 Ultra and Muse Glimmer 30B are its NVIDIA backups; Gemini Flash after them. Kimi K2.6 removed (404 for this account). MiniMax M3.1 Flash removed from design/art (reasons for minutes on design prompts) — kept for light roles + late vision.

primary._comment: DESIGN_PRIMARY=nvidia (legacy value nvidia-kimi works too), with ALLOW_NVIDIA_PRODUCTION=true, puts the NVIDIA design models first for design + art (so revision/polish passes too), Gemini Flash right after. Order = env NVIDIA_DESIGN_MODELS (comma-separated NVIDIA model ids, e.g. 'nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-120b-a12b,nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b') if set, else prepend below. DESIGN_PRIMARY=gemini (or unset) = Gemini first again.

nvidia._anchorNote: afterAnchors routes go after the last of these routes (the strong free backups), before OpenRouter/Gemma/gpt-oss.
nvidia._tested_2026_11_01: 1 Nov 2026 (13:10-13:30Z, Nitish's key, 85 models listed): 404 'Not found for account' = kimi-k2.6, mistral-large-2, nemotron-3-super, nemotron-4-340b, llama-3.1-nemotron-ultra-253b/70b, palmyra-creative, yi-large, jamba-1.5-large, mixtral-8x22b. Real design prompt (one slide, 12k max tokens, streaming): nemotron-3.5-super-vl 8.6 s full valid slide; nemotron-3-ultra 76 s (33 s queue) valid, best layout; muse-glimmer-30b 34 s valid; nemotron-3.5-lightning 35 s valid but broken layout (too weak); minimax-m3.1-flash reasoned 150 s+ with no content (thinking not switchable); mistral-large-4 reasoned 150 s+ no content; step-5-preview, deepseek-v4.1-flash, gemma-4-31b no first byte in 150 s; glm-5.3-flash first byte at 125 s; llama-3.2-90b-vision too slow (1.4k chars in 150 s). No Qwen / Llama 4 / gpt-oss-120b on this account's list.

aliases._comment: Alias -> the model that actually serves it (same quota). ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/deprecations, read 1 Nov 2026; gemini-3-flash-preview = gemini-3-flash per Google's 429 replies.

engineV3._revisionComment: Revision/polish passes (designer.reviseSlide, pass 'revision'): while more than V3_GEMINI_DRAFT_RESERVE (default 30) Gemini Flash calls are left today they use the normal design chain; below that they start at revisionBackups (Nemotron 3.5 Super VL when ALLOW_NVIDIA_PRODUCTION=true, then Mistral Large 4, DeepSeek-V3.1, GLM-4.7-Flash, Nemotron 3 Ultra) and Gemini follows them, so the last Gemini calls go to first drafts. Same number of design calls and polish passes; only the model order changes. V3_REVISION_ROUTE=gemini-first turns this off, =backup-first always uses backups first.
engineV3._v4Comment: engine-v4 (1 Nov 2026 tool-calling test): planner + per-slide designer agents use OpenAI-style tool calls. Super VL 100% valid tool calls (~8 requests/slide); backups Lightning -> Muse Glimmer -> Ultra -> Super VL :free on OpenRouter. Avoid MiniMax, gpt-oss-20b, Groq Qwen, Mistral, SambaNova for tool loops. groq gpt-oss-120b is the last-resort agent route (94% valid tool calls).
